note: CBB zfix: cbb.venue_scorekeeper_stat_bias now defines the rebound offset that player_rebounds_assists stage s6 applies (measurement); cbb.concurrent_vacancy_competition gets provenance (market_free is set directly in catalog and review).

cbb.venue_scorekeeper_stat_bias.measurement: For each arena compute (assists per 100 team FGM recorded for the home team minus the same teams' away rate) minus league mean home gap, using 3 seasons with shrinkage n/(n+300 team games); likewise blocks per 100 opponent two-point attempts, and rebounds credited to the team's players per 100 available misses (all missed field goals and live missed free throws by both teams, the rebound pool of cbb.rebound_pool) with the same home-minus-away gap, shrinkage and league-mean subtraction; apply each as a multiplicative adjustment to the matching stat's rate (assist, block, rebound) capped at +/-6 percent; SOURCE_UNVERIFIED that any of these effects exists in college data at this size, and the rebound offset is the least established of the three (credit differences on team versus individual rebounds are assumed, not documented here), so it is shrunk toward zero hardest and may be set to zero until estimated.
